ingredients.name: CARBOMER HOMOPOLYMER TYPE C (ALLYL PENTAERYTHRITOL CROSSLINKED)

name: BRINZOLAMIDE
indications_original: Brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension is a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor indicated in the treatment of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with ocular hypertension or open-angle glaucoma.
contraindications_original: The recommended dose is one drop of brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension in the affected eye(s) 3 times daily. Brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension may be used concomitantly with other topical ophthalmic drug products to lower IOP. If more than one topical ophthalmic drug is being used, the drugs should be administered at least 10 minutes apart.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension USP, 1% is supplied in natural, round boston, LDPE bottles with an extended controlled drop tip LLDPE tip as follows:
                  10 mL NDC 68682-464-10
                  15 mL NDC 68682-464-15
                  
                     Storage and Handling
                  
                  Store brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension USP, 1% at 4° to 30°C (39° to 86°F). Shake well before use. After opening, brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension USP, 1% can be used until the expiration date on the bottle.
adverseReactions_original: Brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension is contraindicated in patients who are hypersensitive to any component of this product.
